content:
Quick answer

For futsal and indoor soccer, MOMUTO makes lighter, custom jerseys — your colors, crest and numbers — in breathable polyester/elastane with full dye-sublimation, no minimum order. Draft in 24–48 h, delivery in 25–30 days.

Jerseys built for the indoor game

Futsal and indoor soccer are faster, tighter, sweatier. A sublimated polyester/elastane jersey wicks moisture and moves with you — no heavy transfers, no cracked prints. Start from the free 3D designer or send a concept to a designer.

Small rosters, no minimum order

A futsal or indoor soccer roster is small — often 8 to 12 players. There is no minimum order, so you outfit exactly the players you have, from youth XS to adult 4XL. Size guide.

Numbers, names and a sponsor

Names, numbers and a local sponsor are printed into the fabric at no extra cost. Pick a strong two-color base so numbers read clearly under indoor lighting.

Frequently asked questions

Can I order just 8 futsal jerseys?

Yes — there is no minimum order. You can order from one jersey up to a full roster; the per-jersey price drops with quantity.

Is the fabric different from an outdoor jersey?

Same polyester/elastane base built for breathability and movement, ideal for the indoor game. Full sublimation keeps the print flat and durable.

Can we add player names and numbers?

Yes, printed into the fabric — names, numbers and sponsors, with no peeling.
